notes: Added missing schema/contract and core orchestration coverage for facade.

stories.title: Define EvaluateCare Facade Input/Output Contracts
stories.description: Establish explicit request/response schemas for evaluate_care_facade operations (clinical trials search and provider detail lookup), aligning with existing Pydantic tool models and ensuring consistent structured outputs for downstream rendering.

stories.title: Implement Core Orchestration Logic in EvaluateCare Facade
stories.description: Implement orchestration logic within evaluate_care_facade to coordinate clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service, including input normalization, service invocation sequencing, aggregation, and response formatting.

stories.title: Standardize Facade Error Handling and Response Shaping
stories.description: Add consistent error handling, fallback behavior, and user-safe response shaping within evaluate_care_facade to handle upstream API failures, empty datasets, and partial results without breaking the chat flow.
